creator.name: Nam Học AI
creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: Full screen all along (layout seam 0): no paper, no split. The screen recording (or camera) fills the frame; every graphic sits ON the video.
Captions: white Inter 700, lowercase, about 58 px, at y 1480 (chest height, never on the mouth or on the screen's key area), each word appears when said.
Graphics land on the exact word that names them and STACK one by one (never all at once). Stickers snap in, no fade, no slide.
Torn white paper stickers (marker font Pangolin, black): build them from assets/components/stickers.html (copy to source/, edit window.STICKERS, capture --alpha) and wire as an overlay.

List videos: each item = number on a small torn square + item name (Archivo 800) on a torn strip + a marker subtitle under it, top of the frame (y 250 to 450), with the tool's REAL logo above it. New item = clear the previous one.
Images/screens: one rectangular card at a time, 55 to 70 % of the frame width, centered around y 700 to 900, hard pop in and hard cut out, often with a torn sticker overlapping its bottom edge.
Hook (first 3 s): a stacked title at the top: a small marker line, one HUGE accent word (#EF5D0C, Archivo 800), a marker sticker under it.

Sound: music almost inaudible (original: 30 dB or more under the voice, no beat); a soft pop only when stickers stack (2 to 3 times a short), never on every entrance, no whoosh, no riser. Face never above 30 % of the frame height, no punch-in.
Comment word: one keyword per video, tied to that video's guide (e.g. EDIT). No emoji on screen or in captions.
Never Archivo Black, Poppins, DM Sans or Instrument Serif: no Vietnamese diacritics. Use Archivo, Inter, Bricolage Grotesque, JetBrains Mono or Pangolin.
